research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Millibatt, Inc is engaged in developing battery separator technologies, as described in the system and method for depositing separator material, which details dispensing separator material droplets onto a substrate tape. The company is also researching three-dimensional folded battery units and methods for manufacturing them, as well as methods for forming 3D batteries with horizontally-interdigitated electrodes. These activities focus on separator material deposition and advanced battery architectures.

about_short_description.short_description: Millibatt is a battery materials company developing a new separator technology eliminating the primary cause of battery fires.

product.name: SafeCoat™ DDS (Direct Deposition Separator)
product.description: A sprayed porous polymer separator coating applied directly to battery electrodes to replace traditional plastic film separators, improving safety and manufacturing yield.

product.name: Nimbus™ ZEA (Z-Fold Electrode Architecture)
product.description: A folded electrode design for small rechargeable batteries that increases energy capacity and battery life by improving internal space utilization and electrode surface area.
